name: Vintage Washed Baggy Denim Overalls

swap_rule: Reference the look by its ID. Preserve the oversized wide-leg cut, low waist, long shoulder straps, washed denim finish and open torso.

bottom.bib: low front bib with deep side openings exposing the white crop top and midriff
bottom.straps: long adjustable denim shoulder straps extending vertically over the shoulders
bottom.pockets: large front utility pockets and wide rectangular patch pockets on the thighs
bottom.legs: extra-wide straight legs with generous fabric volume
bottom.length: floor-length, fabric pooling slightly over the footwear
bottom.wash: strong vintage stonewash with uneven cloudy fading
bottom.finish: authentic aged denim, worn-in and heavily washed
bottom.distressing: natural faded abrasion along seams, pocket edges, knees and hems, without large holes
bottom.fabric_behavior: Heavy loose denim falling in long vertical folds, with natural bunching around the ankles and irregular washed texture.

style: 1990s oversized vintage denim, relaxed alternative rock stage fashion, authentic worn texture, natural fabric weight, photorealistic
